headline: Falcons' Kendal Daniels hurts neck on tackle vs. Bears, hospitalized
summary: Kendal Daniels is alert and has movement in all his extremities, the Falcons said Sunday, after he injured his neck on a tackle attempt vs. the Bears.

headline: Fairbairn's last-second 49-yard FG gives Texans 34-31 win over Jaguars at Wembley Stadium
summary: — Trying to seal a desperately needed win, Houston Texans quarterback C.J. Stroud threw an interception in the end zone and gave the Jacksonville Jaguars another chance on Sunday.

headline: Texans safety Reed Blankenship suffers concussion vs. Jaguars in London
summary: The Texans lost starting safety Reed Blankenship to a concussion in the second quarter of Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London.

headline: Caleb Williams officially active for the Bears on Sunday
summary: Williams is returning from missing three games with a hamstring injury.

headline: Sauce Gardner questionable to return with calf injury
summary: The Colts are dealing with an injury to one of their key defensive players.

headline: Chargers Expecting Turnaround, Rebuffing Trade Inquiries
summary: The Chargers are presently sitting at 0-5 and therefore look like they will be sellers at next month’s deadline. A handful of notable players like Khalil Mack, Tuli Tuipulotu, and Quentin Johnston have already been mentioned in trade rumors.
